title: US strikes Iranian missile site on Qeshm Island after drone attack on Bahrain
caption:
US jets struck a Revolutionary Guards missile launch site on Iran's Qeshm Island, a US official says, after Iran said it sent drones at a US radar in Bahrain. The US military says the drones were intercepted without damage, and Kuwait reported drone attacks overnight. Trump is due to meet Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in China on Thursday, with the Iran war on the agenda.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
